remarks:
This 107.8 acre property includes a cabin, spring-fed pond, and excellent hunting land located in Belfast NY, Allegany County.

The long gravel drive, hardwood ridges, established trails, and a spring-fed pond define this recreational property. Set several hundred feet off a maintained year-round road, the property offers the privacy, habitat, and accessibility that serious sportsmen and outdoor enthusiasts look for.

The two-bedroom cabin sits in a secluded setting with a large open yard and long-range country views. Inside features an open-concept layout, half bath, wood stove, and electric baseboard heat, making the cabin comfortable for use throughout the hunting season and beyond. The yard provides ample space for campers, equipment, outdoor entertaining, and large gatherings with family and friends. A 20×20 SteelMaster garage on a poured concrete pad provides additional storage.

The land offers an excellent mix of hardwoods, pine cover, open ground, and thick regrowth created from a selective timber harvest completed several years ago. The established trail network provides easy access throughout the property for ATV riding, hiking, and hunting. The regrowth has also created ideal bedding cover and natural browse with multiple areas well suited for future food plots.

Whitetail sign is abundant throughout the property with active travel corridors, bedding areas, and strong habitat diversity across the acreage. Whether you enjoy bow hunting, gun season, trail riding, or simply owning recreational land with proven wildlife potential, this property is set up to be enjoyed immediately.

The spring-fed pond adds another great feature to the property and complements the balance of woods, trails, and open space that make this a true four-season getaway.  All rights convey.
